request.text_prompt: Create original cold cinematic science-fiction game audio, approximately 4 seconds. A few isolated human boot footfalls on a spacecraft deck; only footsteps, no speech or breathing. Hurried light boots over ribbed alloy flooring, six uneven steps and one heel scuff. One self-contained event or specified short sequence; clear attack, natural decay, quiet clean tail; no abrupt truncation or long dead air. No vocals, singing, humming, speech, narration, lyrics or spoken prompt. No clipping, harsh distortion or unrelated scene sounds. No music, melody or soundtrack.
